Preview host & address.question: Which machine runs Preview? (asked whether cloud is suitable)
Preview host & address.answer: Local machine already owned: the developer's Dev laptop for now; may port to other hardware later. Cloud explained (Preview workable with Tailscale + exception; Home not advised) and declined.

Preview host & address.question: Always-on vs laptop uptime
Preview host & address.answer: Accept for now: Preview is available whenever the laptop is on at home; try-outs at agreed times; always-on returns after moving to a dedicated box. Reword success criterion 1.

Preview host & address.question: Stable address
Preview host & address.answer: Router DHCP IP reservation for the laptop; Preview at <ip>:8124.

Preview host & address.question: Portability
Preview host & address.answer: Fresh seed on new host: copy repo + one env file, run reset-preview; host-agnostic tooling (any Linux/macOS with Docker Compose v2), no laptop-specific paths.

Preview host & address.question: Home hardware
